name: scirepl-mcp-repository
description: Independent MCP servers for SciREPL app integration and browser automation

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/broker ci && npm --prefix packages/playwright-driver ci
scripts.check: npm --prefix packages/broker run check && npm --prefix packages/playwright-driver run check
scripts.test: npm run test:broker && npm run test:playwright
scripts.audit: npm --prefix packages/broker run audit && npm --prefix packages/playwright-driver run audit
